name: path-of-ragnarok
author: rhewid
description: A Path-of-Exile style passive skill tree. Your first class gives you an origin in the centre of a 695-node tree, every job level earns a point (50 max), and you grow outward through stats, resistances, damage against races and elements, skill boosts, auto-casts and free recasts, card sockets, masteries, job-line and rebirth branches, keystones and teleport rifts. Balanced around pre-renewal; it also loads on renewal but is not balanced for it.
